issue: पवन वेग सम सम तनु बलधारी — सम is printed twice; the only other copy found (InstaAstro) copies Drik Panchang. A doubled word typed by mistake, or 'swift as the wind, with an even (sama) body'?
our reading: पवन वेग सम सम तनु बलधारी, as Drik Panchang prints it: swift as the wind, of well-proportioned body, mighty.
alternatives: पवन वेग सम तनु बलधारी (one सम).

issue: उसकी कला हो सदा सवाई: कला 'skill, power, fortune'; सवाई 'one and a quarter', the idiom of ever-growing increase.
our reading: his powers ever grow by a quarter more.

issue: कुबेर की माई: Kubera's mother (Iḍaviḍā, named in cau8), or the Mother goddess (Lakṣmī) worshipped with him.
alternatives: Lakṣmī, the Goddess who goes with Kubera.
